person_candidates.page_context: President and Vice-Chancellor Professor Duncan Ivison “Manchester is an extraordinary university; deeply embedded in the city and with a strong sense of place. You feel like you’re in a city that has a bit of swagger, a bit of heart and soul. And yet it also has global aspirations. That combination is rare.” The chief executive and academic leader of the University, Duncan previously held positions at the Australian National University, the University of York (UK), the University of Toronto and the University of Sydney, where he was Deputy Vice Chancellor (Research).
